scripts.build: rm -rf ../token-storage && npm run data && npm run charts && slidev build token-storage.md --base /token-storage/ --out ../token-storage
scripts.export: echo 'Run: pnpm dev, then open http://localhost:3030/export (browser exporter, no playwright needed)'
scripts.charts: rm -rf public/charts && for c in ratio corpora chunk-ratio chunk-encode chunk-read agent-read agent-write frontier hero; do CHART=$c vite build --config charts/vite.config.mjs || exit 1; done
scripts.charts:splade: for c in activations quality-latency latency-split throughput spread nano-means recall-tail; do CHART=$c vite build --config charts/vite.config.mjs || exit 1; done
scripts.build:splade: rm -rf ../if-splade && npm run charts:splade && slidev build if-splade.md --base /if-splade/ --out ../if-splade
